decisions.reason: 本轮非实时两条语音计算RTF中位数0.308、实时推理窗峰值PSS约116MiB；FP32相应约0.371/156MiB。唯一有独立参考的音频两者CER均20/37=54.1%，不能宣称中文质量达标。
decisions.next_experiment: 固定原6条小集复核专名/数字和另一条独立公开转写；质量可接受后再确定三轮复测配置。

decisions.disposition: 保留质量对照，不作为当前默认资源方案
decisions.reason: 本轮未见独立参考CER改善；计算RTF和PSS高于混合INT8，结论只覆盖两个部署组合，不是CPU/NPU后端收益。
decisions.next_experiment: 与INT8保持同源输入和参数作输出对照，避免只按更快决定质量。

decisions.disposition: 需要调整或对比后再复测
decisions.reason: 固定6条任务中5条通过文本rubric；无温度传感器仍编造20摄氏度。TTFT中位数8.780秒，可播中文首句中位数11.145秒（5条，JSON任务无中文句号不计）。原生日志prompt处理约7.94–10.75秒，与首内容等待接近；独立根因剖析未做。
decisions.next_experiment: 保留未知事实失败用例，分开验证短提示/前缀缓存等等待假设与另一入围模型的质量；每项更改另建实验，不重复宣称当前已适合交互。

decisions.disposition: 暂缓按当前配置进入三轮复测，优先调整合成等待
decisions.reason: 4条文本均生成有效PCM16 WAV，但首PCM等待18.85–25.76秒、合成RTF6.23–7.51；这是整句返回，不是流式首包。发音和自然度尚无人试听，不能当作发音合格。
decisions.next_experiment: 先按固定4条文本试听数字/日期/否定句并记录结果，再在独立预算内检查更轻部署或前端/模型耗时；未经复测不推导优化效果。

data_contract_note: v2 Python ASR/LLM/TTS adapters; not compatible with ASR-lite-v1 execution validator; metric units/boundaries below and phase metric objects retained

metric_definitions.asr_compute_rtf: feature/decode/result/reset/EOF wall computation including 3.2s zero tail divided by original audio duration; pacing/loading excluded
metric_definitions.asr_first_partial: first nonempty text minus first block submission; realtime cases only
metric_definitions.asr_final: last nonempty endpoint final minus scheduled file end or declared energy anchor; EOF forced text excluded from endpoint waiting
metric_definitions.asr_pacing: 100ms chunks scheduled at audio block start, not v1 block-end convention; cannot compare v1 waits directly
metric_definitions.llm_ttft: request to first nonempty content chunk; not model-only token timing
metric_definitions.llm_sentence: request to first 。！？ closed sentence; structured JSON may have no such sentence
metric_definitions.tts_pcm: whole utterance return plus PCM16 conversion; file writes excluded, no speaker first sound measured
metric_definitions.phase_cpu: sample-bracket or interior sample CPU deltas, duration-weighted over repeated phase windows; raw scope per window
metric_definitions.pss: 200ms sampled process-tree PSS; not kernel high-watermark or entire host memory

limitations: one process round, three ASR materials reused across four configurations; only one independently transcribed ASR clip
asset hashing warms filesystem cache; startup is not cold-disk latency
no stable P95 or long-run thermal claim
LLM rubric review is text inspection, not a large quality benchmark
TTS pronunciation/naturalness need listening review; no playback during execution
no ROS/YOLO coexistence, microphone, AEC, interruption, or full interaction acceptance
